FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.label: Great Khans Standing
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.drillDesc: Trade blows with any colonist to test your mettle. Both stop, stand apart, and draw their weapons. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.studyDesc: Cook up a batch alongside another colonist on the chemist's road, trading technique. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.inspectDesc: Check a lower-ranked tribemate's weapon and gear. Well-kept gear earns respect, neglected gear earns scorn.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.punishDesc: Put a lower-ranked tribemate to work for a stretch as payback for stepping out of line, souring their mood. Once per day per tribemate.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.rallyDesc: Rouse every combat-ranked tribemate of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and fury. Once every few days.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.fallInDesc: Call {0} to circle up behind you, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They hold until you break it up.
FCP.Ranks.RankTrackDef.dismissDesc: Break up the circle, letting {0} go back to what they were doing.
